title: TIOCSWINSZ changes size without generating SIGWINCH
mechanism: The SetWinSize arm of Tty::ioctl, which PtyMaster::ioctl also forwards to, only calls LineDiscipline::set_window_size, an assignment, so no SIGWINCH is queued for the foreground process group when the size changes.
contract: TIOCSWINSZ(2const): when the window size changes, SIGWINCH is sent to the terminal's foreground process group.
observed: By source reading at the pin (not run): the new size is visible through TIOCGWINSZ, but no SIGWINCH is generated.

repro.how_to_run: Run `make static` in repro/ on x86-64 Linux, copy bin/abi_probe into an Asterinas guest, and run `abi_probe <case>` for tty_winsize_signal. repro/README.md gives the saved Linux output.

caveats: SOURCE LEAD, Asterinas NOT_RUN. Observe the signal, not only the getter. Setting the same size again is a separate question. Needs working setsid, TIOCSCTTY and tcsetpgrp. Legacy text-only probe.
